objective: Discover permitted remaining-usage sources and establish an evidence-bound capacity-signal contract for BitCadence without changing routing, credentials, provider configuration, or spend.
constraints: U01 is read-only: do not alter account settings, provider configuration, credentials, routing, budgets, scheduled tasks, or cloud resources.
Do not scrape or automate a provider dashboard. Accept only official APIs, documented local CLI output, or provider-issued rate-limit headers as candidate sources.
Never record API keys, cookies, email addresses, raw account pages, or unredacted command output in artifacts, audit records, fixtures, or logs.
Unknown capacity remains explicit. It must not be converted to zero, inferred from token use, or treated as fresh capacity.
Jev does not determine usage, quotas, resets, budgets, or routing eligibility. Numeric policy remains deterministic code.
A provider without a permitted, reproducible usage source remains unmetered and cannot justify automatic capacity-aware routing.
Every finding must include source type, observed freshness, account reference shape, redaction behavior, and a reproducible non-secret fixture or a documented reason it cannot exist.

tasks.title: Audit permitted remaining-usage sources and capacity-signal boundaries
tasks.instructions: Repository: mastalink/BitCadence. Read docs/USAGE-CAPACITY-SIGNAL.md, current provider health/quota schema, routing code, adapters, local worker launchers, and the configured provider integration seams. Produce a redacted evidence report under the Score artifact root. For each configured provider/account class, classify the best candidate source as official API, documented local CLI output, rate-limit header, no permitted source, or requires a later human/contract decision. Define exact normalized fields, freshness thresholds, error/unknown semantics, opaque account-reference rules, and fixture strategy. Verify no candidate approach requires a dashboard scrape or secret exposure. Do not edit repository files, start browser automation, call paid model APIs, change a provider, or launch a worker. Return strict JSON with the evidence artifact paths and a machine-readable proposed adapter inventory.

tasks.title: Independently verify the U01 capacity-signal audit
tasks.instructions: Independently review the exact U01 audit artifacts and the cited BitCadence code. Verify that every claimed provider source is permitted and reproducible without dashboard automation or secret leakage; unknown is not treated as capacity; the proposed contract preserves deterministic routing and does not grant Jev, a provider, or an account additional authority; and no unsupported source was presented as available. Return strict JSON with pass/fail, exact artifact digests reviewed, approved candidate sources, rejected sources, and blockers for U02. Do not edit repository files, configure providers, or merge work.
